rubric.evidence: Verified directly against whatwg/html#10327 diff, HTML Living Standard module map / fetch a single module script, Blink module_map.cc (ModuleMapDoNotCacheFailedFetch, NotifyNewSingleModuleFinished, RemoveEntry), WPT dynamic-import & json-module repeated-imports.any.js, BCD javascript/operators/import.json (http_errors_not_cached), and ChromeStatus 5214647044145152 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5214647044145152 is listed under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=156 with exact listing name 'Avoid caching module failures'; slug matches slugify(); H1 matches listing name; ChromeStatus table row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5214647044145152.

Full implementation-sufficient reference justified because MDN's import() page only has a single short paragraph on module-map caching. Covers failed fetch eviction (network, non-ok HTTP status, CORS/SRI, MIME mismatch), callback-list deduplication, cached SyntaxError/evaluation errors, transitive dependencies, HTTP cache separation, and worker module maps across all 9 dimensions.

Includes a 7-row failure caching matrix distinguishing evictable fetch/MIME TypeErrors from sticky SyntaxErrors/evaluation throws, explains callback-list deduplication replacing the legacy 'fetching' sentinel, and highlights the Cache-Control HTTP cache pitfall.

Embeds live HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase demo (flaky-network-recovery/) with sandbox and referrerpolicy, links both sibling concept demos, and provides an exponential-backoff importWithRetry() helper and JSON module retry example validated by scripts/doc-tests.mjs.
Accurately documents BCD http_errors_not_cached (Chrome 156, Edge 156, Firefox 155, Safari preview) and explains legacy-browser fallback considerations.

Every visible source and citation label carries a direct external <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; all 3 CPS concept URLs, CPS feature root, and CPS conformance HTML/JSON HEAD-checked 200 on 2026-11-27; feature-root links marked data-demo-rel='related' so flaky-network-recovery/ is cleanly selected.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, descriptive iframe title, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical sizing (inline-size, max-inline-size), display: block on embedded iframe, and horizontally scrollable tables without horizontal document overflow.

Verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27 for https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v156/avoid-caching-module-failures/flaky-network-recovery/ and parent conformance suite (release v156, featureSlug avoid-caching-module-failures, chromestatusId 5214647044145152).
